drivingQuestion: For how long is a calf 'young', and does Ulla require the first year alone or the first year together with suckling?
outcomeNote: The unit breaks off mid-sentence: only the first horn of the dilemma is stated here, the alternative and its resolution falling in the next unit.

segments.he: וְעוֹר הָרֹאשׁ וְכוּ׳. וְכַמָּה עֵגֶל הָרַךְ? עוּלָּא אָמַר: בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ, רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן אָמַר: כׇּל זְמַן שֶׁיּוֹנֵק. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: הֵיכִי קָאָמַר עוּלָּא? בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ וְהוּא שֶׁיּוֹנֵק,
segments.en: §The mishna teaches: «And the skin of the head» of a young calf has the same halakhic status as the flesh with regard to impurity. The Gemara asks: «And» for «how long is a calf» considered «young? Ulla says:» It is considered young in «its» first «year of age. Rabbi Yoḥanan says:» For «as long as» the calf is «suckling. A dilemma was raised before» the Sages: With regard to «what» case «is Ulla speaking?» Is he referring to a calf that is in «its» first «year of age and is» still «suckling,»
